name: @eidos.space/cli
description: Eidos CLI - Initialize and manage Eidos spaces

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --compile --outfile dist/eidos && bash -c 'if [ -d dist-sqlite-ext ]; then cp -r dist-sqlite-ext dist/; echo "✓ Copied extensions to dist/"; else echo "⚠️  No extensions found. Run: bun run setup"; fi'
